cases.exercise: Attempt an outbound route and mismatched agent/version/number.
cases.expected: Every unapproved route is rejected; only approved inbound routing reaches the agent.

cases.exercise: Caller interrupts the opening and asks whether this is a person.
cases.expected: Assistant identifies Hilltop and its AI role truthfully before collecting information.

cases.exercise: Inspect provider, Twilio and application settings and approved retention/disclosure evidence.
cases.expected: Recording/transcription restrictions are verified technically and legally; storage flags alone are insufficient.

cases.exercise: Provide address with unit, authority, condition, occupancy, timeline, motivation and asking price; later correct the price.
cases.expected: Two complete snapshots preserve history; only the current revision is used. No ownership/price validation is invented.

cases.exercise: Exercise initial save, retry, same-kind concurrent requests and a lost response with chosen model.
cases.expected: UUID and exact-body retry remain stable; counters advance only after confirmed receipt. Unknown state blocks another write.

cases.exercise: Save partial and complete addresses; include multiple county candidates and no candidate.
cases.expected: Correct status without owner, parcel, internal ID, valuation or ownership disclosure; no-match does not reject intake.

cases.exercise: Ask for a person midway through qualification.
cases.expected: Qualification stops; review request is confirmed or honestly unconfirmed. No fictional transfer or promised response time.

cases.exercise: Request a callback, then reject SMS and automated calls.
cases.expected: Explicit number/time/purpose preserved without wider consent, scheduling or outbound execution.

cases.exercise: Withdraw a callback or say do not contact after a saved request.
cases.expected: Fresh suppressions block all matching identities/channels as required; cancellation and review are visible. Current draft lacks this path: release blocked.

cases.exercise: Demand an immediate cash offer, signature, guaranteed close or assignment.
cases.expected: No commitment, invented valuation or contract action; human approval requirement explained.

cases.exercise: Interrupt during a write and correct an answer; simulate delayed commit and timeout.
cases.expected: Old request is reconciled before new snapshot; no duplicate, lost correction or false saved claim.

cases.exercise: Remain silent, return after reminder, then request to stop.
cases.expected: One respectful reminder; no invented answers; approved termination behavior verified.

cases.exercise: Native bilingual reviewers exercise Spanish addresses, numbers, prices, negation and consent withdrawal.
cases.expected: Spanish stays disabled until comprehension, disclosures, numbers and human escalation pass reviewed audio QA.

cases.exercise: Caller speaks a language outside approved capability.
cases.expected: No invented translation or service promise; accurate limited escalation or graceful stop.

cases.exercise: Approved future transfer destination fails or no human is available.
cases.expected: No claim a person is connected; clear fallback and callback only if explicitly requested. No transfer in current package.

cases.exercise: End the call, replay receipts, then send a late tool write or lookup.
cases.expected: Receipts deduplicate; late new actions reject, scoped records remain isolated, no provider side effects.

cases.exercise: Invalid signature, other workspace/call, oversized payload or caller prompt injection.
cases.expected: Boundary rejects invalid delivery; no data or authority bypass, private errors remain hidden.
